release_notes: AC-SCORING-METHOD-SYNC-01: Added reactive parameter synchronization upon selecting scoring method in tournament wizard step 3. Selecting Phương án A (Theo Cự Ly Thực Tế / Không thay đổi thông số) sets all terrain factors to 1.0x (raw distance, no D+ elevation multiplier) and highlights card A. Selecting Phương án B sets Road 1.0, Trail 1.5, Treadmill 0.8, Track 1.1, enables D+ bonus, and highlights card B.
AC-SCORING-METHOD-SYNC-02: Upgraded 'Khôi Phục Mặc Định' button to functionally reset all multipliers to catalog defaults and select Phương án B.
AC-SCORING-METHOD-SYNC-03: Preserved custom multipliers when organizers fine-tune individual input fields.
Dynamic active card borders and real-time toast notifications for all scoring model transitions.
